title: The effective circle acts faithfully and reprimitiveizes the spherical charges

effective_quotient.definition: C_eff=C/{1,z}, with quotient coordinate beta=2 alpha modulo 2 pi.
effective_quotient.faithfulness: K1712 proves {1,z} is the exact original action kernel, so the descended C_eff action on H_ps is faithful.
effective_quotient.generator: U(alpha)=exp(i alpha Q)=exp(i beta Q_eff) with Q_eff=Q/2.
effective_quotient.ktype_weights: K1357's weights {-4,-2,0,2,4} become {-2,-1,0,1,2}; their gcd is one.
effective_quotient.topology: The projection C to C_eff has degree two and is not an automorphism of the original circle.
effective_quotient.kinetic_normalization: The primitive effective generator is T_eff=T/2, so K1356's normalized quadratic norm becomes 1/4.
effective_quotient.local_equivalence: K1451's rescaling with c=1/2 gives Q_eff=Q/2, A_eff=2A, kappa_eff=kappa/4 and mu_eff=4mu, preserving the local covariant derivative, kinetic and regularizer terms.
effective_quotient.physical_ceiling: The quotient removes the internal parity obstruction but changes the global gauge group and normalization. Source/action ownership, physical carrier, observed intertwiner and kinetic coefficient remain absent.

claim_ceiling: Passing to the exact effective quotient repairs the internal charge-lattice parity obstruction and yields a faithful primitive representation with a precisely rescaled kinetic normalization. It is a changed global group, not an automorphism of the original circle, and remains repository-selected rather than source- or action-owned.
